E_C3_corrected.how: round19/C3 measures an INDEPENDENT per-glyph reader at 95.56 % on the LP2 typeface, i.e. a reader error rate of 4.44 %. R9's observed DISAGREEMENT rate is only 3.07 % and frontB's 2.00 % — both BELOW the reader's own error rate. Under p_disagree ~= p_reader + p_canon, p_canon <= 3.07 - 4.44 < 0, i.e. the disagreements are fully explained by the instrument and carry no evidence of canon error.
